title: Bones after 50: calcium, vitamin D and the foods that carry them

posts.facebook:
Calcium builds bone and vitamin D lets you absorb it. Most of both can come from an ordinary shopping basket.

What calcium and vitamin D do for bones after 50, the daily amounts the NHS, Royal Osteoporosis Society and US National Institutes of Health suggest, and a table of everyday foods with their calcium content. No supplement regimes — just the official guidance and where to find it.

Aim for calcium from food at every meal, get vitamin D from daylight in summer, and ask your GP about the official autumn-and-winter guidance.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/eat/bones-after-50-calcium-vitamin-d-and-food/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
